hints.title: Double Score Condition
hints.text: A frame earns double points if ten pins were hit in either of the two preceding frames.

hints.title: Score Evaluation Function
hints.text: Compute total points for each player using a helper that tracks the previous two rolls.

hints.title: Comparison and Winner Determination
hints.text: Return 1 if player one has strictly more points, 2 if player two has strictly more points, and 0 on equality.

hints.title: Bowling Evaluation Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass simulating scoring rules for both players.
